thread:
maya: Heads-up — I'm drafting the relnotes for next docs push (target: Thursday). Need quick review on copy + a couple of known-issue callouts. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4872 :wave:

toni: SG. Which sections need eyes? UX copy or technical bits?

maya: Mostly UX copy for the 'Model routing' blurb and a short note about the Python SDK streaming example being out-of-date. Also two link fixes from the link-checker report. I left a proposed blurb in the PR description.

eli: Can you paste the blurb here? I'll skim. :eyes:

maya: "Model routing: Requests now respect per-route latency and cost policies for compatible fallback routing. This reduces tail latencies when preferred capacity is constrained. Note: canary users will see enforced routing rules starting on release day." Thoughts?

toni: Nice — concise. Maybe replace "enforced" with "applied" to avoid sounding punitive.

maya: Good call. Updated in the PR.

sam: Re: Python SDK streaming example: PR #4890 in the SDK repo updated the streaming API signature last week. Docs example still shows the old `on_chunk` handler. Suggest we add a small migration snippet:

    # old
    client.stream("model", on_chunk=handle)

    # new
    async for chunk in client.stream("model"):
      handle(chunk)

maya: I added that snippet to the PR but kept it collapsed behind a "Migration note" toggle.

doc-bot: link-checker: 2 broken links found in /docs/guides/batching.md (line ~42), /docs/reference/sdk/python.md (line ~211). See issue: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/issues/1324

ana: I'm on the batching.md fix — quick question: the anchor we used changed after the TOC update; do we redirect or re-anchor? Redirect seems safest for external links.

maya: Agree. Added a 301 redirect entry in /_redirects and noted it in the PR.

eli: Anything for the changelog "known issues" section? We should mention the SDK streaming mismatch and also a regression where rate-limit headers occasionally drop in Dedicated for short bursts.

maya: Added both as short bullets under "Known issues" — kept language non-alarming, with mitigations and a link to the incident page for the rate-limit quirk.

toni: Quick nit: in the relnotes copy, change "tail latencies" -> "tail latency" (singular). Small but reads better.

maya: Fixed. Also formatted the feature date as RFC3339 in the frontmatter.

sam: Do we need a backfill note for customers on Dedicated about the rate-limit header? Ops might want an email template.

maya: Good call — I'll ping customer-success after this thread and attach the short blurb.

doc-bot: deploy-bot: docs-preview build queued for pr-4872 (sha: a7b3f2) — https://deploy-preview.redwood-inference.com/4872

eli: I'll do a quick pass on the code blocks and snippet formatting once the preview is up.

maya: Thanks all. If no objections by EOD tomorrow I'll merge and cut the release notes. :thumbsup:

toni: No objections from me.

sam: Looks good from infra side.

ana: batching link fix merged — will watch analytics for re-crawls.

maya: Closing thread — will post final relnotes link here after merge. Thanks! :rocket:
